{{Top|leg}}
A '''Trojan programme''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program that could be used to restore information deleted from a computer system. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified Cularin system slicer|slicer]] placed a Trojan program into the computer system of the [[Comet Broom Service]]. The program was later activated by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] and used to restore some deleted navigational data, as part of a plot to incriminate the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as having had involvement with Comet Broom's [[Cometary Water Reclamation Project]].
